title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Payments Reference — Cutoff Time, Accepted Methods, Card Surcharge and Returned Payment Fee
content:
Payments on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account are taken under the figures of the account's tier.

| Tier | Cutoff (Eastern Time, business day) | Accepted payment methods | Third-party bank card surcharge (percent of the payment) | Returned payment fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 17:00 | ACH, check, bank card, phone ACH | 0.00 | 29.00 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 17:00 | ACH, check, bank card, phone ACH | 0.00 | 29.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 17:00 | ACH, check, wire, bank card, phone ACH | 2.50 | 35.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 17:00 | ACH, check, wire, bank card, phone ACH | 2.50 | 35.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 17:00 | ACH, check, wire, bank card, phone ACH | 2.50 | 35.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 17:00 | ACH, check, wire, bank card, phone ACH | 2.00 | 35.00 |

## Notes on the figures

- The cutoff is the Eastern Time hour on a business day by which a payment must be received to be credited that day, written on the 24-hour clock.
- Wire transfer is accepted on the Commercial Account tiers only; the two revolving tiers accept ACH, check, bank card and phone ACH.
- A surcharge of 0.00 means no surcharge is charged on that tier.
- The returned payment fee is charged when a payment is returned unpaid.

Hypothetical illustration: a payment of 1000.00 made with a third-party bank card on a Commercial Account Net 45 carries a surcharge of 2.50 percent of 1000.00, that is 25.00; on a Pro Revolving Charge the same payment carries none.
